kind: corrections register for the registry-binding disclosures

corrections.was: pin_drift_erratum_chain_binding.json records the only re-pinned accepted card as card_status_in_state 'NO-ROW' for card 'W05/W05-02'
corrections.now: W05-02 is ACCEPTED in execution/v2.4/step_state.json, with verifier qoder-desktop:/root/w0502_verifier_r1 and verdict ACCEPT_WITH_LIMITATIONS
corrections.root_cause: the generator built the card id from the receipt path parts (W05 + / + W05-02 = W05/W05-02) and looked that slashed string up in step_state, whose rows are keyed W05-02, so the lookup could never match and every card would have been reported NO-ROW
corrections.blast_radius: no registered evidence file and no step_state row carried the false label; it sat in an unregistered disclosure written minutes before the review, and is corrected here rather than by rewriting that file
corrections.guard_now: look up step_state rows by the row id, and assert that a published status is not NO-ROW unless the absence was itself verified

corrections.addresses: P-R6-8 - the registry has one revision_note slot, so each binding overwrites the previous disclosure
corrections.was: the rev-12 disclosure sentence was on the live file face through revision 16 and is absent from the revision-17 face
corrections.now: the note as git held it at each revision is preserved below, so the disclosures stay recoverable without editing the live registry
corrections.recovered_from: git log -- execution/v2.4/commands.json, first commit seen per revision

Consequence disclosed in the checkpoint: the accepted W04-01 receipt pins the rev 10 commands.json hash, which is now historical.

12.revision_note: revision 12 binds test.resources for card W12-01 to go run ./tests/resources/check. The key had no v2.4 entry before, so every test.resources selector resolved through the v2.0 registry (execution/commands.json) to ops/ci/resources.py; adding a v2.4 entry flips resolution for all of them, so the new handler forwards every selector it does not own - W12-G01, W12-G02 and cases C11, C13, C14, C15, C16 - to that same harness and asserts the routing rule itself. Before/after parity for all seven is recorded in receipts/W12/W12-01. Disclosed consequence: this file's hash changes again, which is a second drift against the artifact hashes pinned in the accepted W04-01 receipt (already disclosed by receipts/W04/W04-01/pin_drift_erratum_1.json).
